151std::vector<int> toBin(int number, UINT nBits = 0)
152{
153 // Takes an integer and returns a std::vector containing
154 // its binary representation
155
156 UINT i; // iterate over each bit
157 int bit; // temp storage of each bit
158 std::vector<int> bits; // return vector
159 while (number > 0)
160 {
161 bit = number & 1;
162 number = number >> 1;
163 bits.push_back(bit);
164 }
165 if (nBits > bits.size())
166 {
167 for (i = bits.size(); i < nBits; i++)
168 {
169 bits.push_back(0);
170 }
171 }
172 return bits;
173}

184int toInt(std::vector<int> v)
185{
186 // Takes a std::vector containing the binary representation
187 // of an integer and returns that integer
188
189 int counter = 0; // increasing iterator
190 int result = 0;
191 for (UINT i = 0; i < v.size(); i++)
192 {
193 result = result + v[i] * twoPow(counter);
194 counter++;
195 }
196 return result;
197}

375class tangent {
376 float slope;
377 UINT quadrant;
378 bool err;
379
380public:
381 tangent(float dx, float dy) {
382 init(dx, dy);
383 }
384 void init(float dx, float dy){
385 slope = 0;
386 err = false;
387 if (dx == 0 && dy == 0){
388 //tolog("Incorrect tangent!\n");
389 err = true;
390 }
391 if (dx < 0 && dy <= 0) {
392 quadrant = 1;
393 slope = dy / dx;
394 } else if (dx >= 0 && dy < 0) {
395 quadrant = 2;
396 slope = -dx / dy;
397 } else if (dx > 0 && dy >= 0) {
398 quadrant = 3;
399 slope = dy / dx;
400 } else {
401 quadrant = 4;
402 slope = -dx / dy;
403 }
404 }
405 void init(point p1, point p2){
406 float dx = p2.x - p1.x;
407 float dy = p2.y - p1.y;
408 slope = 0;
409 err = false;
410 init(dx, dy);
411 if (slope != slope){
412 tolog(_L_ + "Incorrect tangent: \n" + p1.croack() + p2.croack());
413 err = true;
414 }
415 }
416 tangent(){}
417 tangent(point p1, point p2){
418 init(p1, p2);
419 }
420 bool error(){
421 return err;
422 }
423 UINT getQuadrant(){
424 return quadrant;
425 }
426 float getSlope(){
427 return slope;
428 }
429 point transformPoint(point p, float r){
430 point result;
431 float sq = slope * slope;
432 float dy = r * sqrt(1/(1+sq));
433 float dx = slope * dy;
434 if (quadrant == 1){
435 result.x = p.x - dy;
436 result.y = p.y - dx;
437 }
438 else if (quadrant == 2){
439 result.x = p.x + dx;
440 result.y = p.y - dy;
441 }
442 else if (quadrant == 3){
443 result.x = p.x + dy;
444 result.y = p.y + dx;
445 }
446 else if (quadrant == 4){
447 result.x = p.x - dx;
448 result.y = p.y + dy;
449 }
450 return result;
451 }
452 //void operator=(tangent t) {
453 // quadrant = t.quadrant;
454 // slope = t.slope;
455 //}
456 void rotate(tangent t) {
457 if (t.quadrant == quadrant && t.slope == slope){
458 slope = 0;
459 quadrant = 1;
460 return;
461 }
462 float tslope = t.slope;
463 float s = slope;
464 if (t.slope > 0) {
465 tslope = 1 / t.slope;
466 } else {
467 quadrant++;
468 }
469 quadrant += 4 - t.quadrant;
470 if ((s * tslope) == 1) {
471 slope = 0;
472 quadrant++;
473 } else {
474 slope = (s + tslope) / (1 - s * tslope);
475 if (slope < 0) {
476 quadrant++;
477 slope = -1 / slope;
478 }
479 }
480 quadrant = (quadrant - 1) % 4 + 1;
481 }
482
483 tangent bisect(tangent t){
484 tangent t1 = *this;
485 tangent t2 = t;
486 tangent d = t1 - t2;
487 tangent h(-1, 1);
488 tangent half(-1, 0);
489 UINT qdiff = d.quadrant - 1;
490 for (UINT i = 0; i < qdiff; i++){
491 half.rotate(h);
492 }
493 float s = d.slope;
494 float s1 = 0;
495 if (s > 0){
496 s1 = (sqrt(1 + s*s) - 1) / s;
497 }
498 tangent rest = tangent(-1, 0);
499 rest.slope = s1;
500 tangent r = half + rest;
501 tangent result = r + t1;
502 return result;
503 }
504
505 tangent leftIntermediate(tangent t){
506 tangent t1 = *this;
507 tangent t2 = t;
508 tangent rv(1, 0);
509 tangent tt = t2 + rv;
510 tangent b = t1.bisect(tt);
511 return b;
512 }
513
514 tangent operator-(tangent t){
515 tangent t1 = *this;
516 tangent t2 = t;
517 t2.rotate(t1);
518 tangent result = t2;
519 return result;
520 }
521
522 tangent operator+(tangent t){
523 tangent result(1, 1);
524 result.quadrant = quadrant;
525 result.quadrant += t.quadrant - 1;
526 float s = slope;
527 float tslope = t.slope;
528 if ((s * tslope) == 1) {
529 result.slope = 0;
530 result.quadrant++;
531 }
532 else{
533 result.slope = (s + tslope) / (1 - s * tslope);
534 }
535 if (result.slope < 0) {
536 result.quadrant++;
537 result.slope = -1 / result.slope;
538 }
539 result.quadrant = (result.quadrant - 1) % 4 + 1;
540 return result;
541 }
542
543 bool operator<(tangent t2) {
544 if (quadrant > t2.quadrant) {
545 return false;
546 } else if (quadrant < t2.quadrant) {
547 return true;
548 } else if (slope < t2.slope) {
549 return true;
550 } else {
551 return false;
552 }
553 }
554 bool operator==(tangent t2){
555 if (slope == t2.slope && quadrant == t2.quadrant){
556 return true;
557 }
558 return false;
559 }
560 bool operator!=(tangent t2){
561 return !(*this == t2);
562 }
563 bool operator<=(tangent t2){
564 if (*this < t2 || *this == t2){
565 return true;
566 }
567 return false;
568 }
569 std::string croack() {
570 std::ostringstream r;
571 r << "Slope: " << slope << "\tQuadrant: " << quadrant << std::endl;
572 return r.str();
573 }
574};

819 point place(scale s, point m){
820 point r;
821 scale tempScale;
822 tempScale.initScale();
823 float offset;
824 float Scale;
825 if (s.ratio() <= ratio())
826 {
827 offset = s.xSpan() - s.ySpan() / ratio();
828 offset /= 2;
829 tempScale.setMinX(offset + s.minX());
830 tempScale.setMaxX(s.maxX() - offset);
831 tempScale.setMinY(s.minY());
832 tempScale.setMaxY(s.maxY());
833 }
834 else
835 {
836 offset = s.ySpan() - ratio() * s.xSpan();
837 offset /= 2;
838 tempScale.setMinX(s.minX());
839 tempScale.setMaxX(s.maxX());
840 tempScale.setMinY(offset + s.minY());
841 tempScale.setMaxY(s.maxY() - offset);
842 }
843 r.x = m.x - minX();
844 r.y = m.y - minY();
845 r.x /= xSpan();
846 r.y /= ySpan();
847 r.x *= tempScale.xSpan();
848 r.y *= tempScale.ySpan();
849 r.x += tempScale.minX();
850 r.y += tempScale.minY();
851 Scale = tempScale.xSpan() / xSpan();
852 r.radius = Scale * m.radius;
853 return r;
854 }

856 void addToScale(point p){
857 if (clear){
858 x = p.x - p.radius;
859 X = p.x + p.radius;
860 y = p.y - p.radius;
861 Y = p.y + p.radius;
862 clear = false;
863 }
864 else{
865 float possib[4] = {
866 p.x - p.radius,
867 p.x + p.radius,
868 p.y - p.radius,
869 p.y + p.radius
870 };
871 for (UINT i = 0; i < 2; i++){
872 if (possib[i] < x){
873 x = possib[i];
874 }
875 else if (possib[i] > X){
876 X = possib[i];
877 }
878 }
879 for (UINT i = 2; i < 4; i++){
880 if (possib[i] < y){
881 y = possib[i];
882 }
883 else if (possib[i] > Y){
884 Y = possib[i];
885 }
886 }
887 }
888 }

984float perimeter(std::vector<point> v, bool close = false)
985{
986 UINT i;
987 float result = 0;
988 float rx, ry;
989 for (i = 0; i < v.size() - 1; i++)
990 {
991 rx = v[i+1].x - v[i].x;
992 ry = v[i+1].y - v[i].y;
993 result += sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry);
994 }
995 if (close)
996 {
997 rx = v[v.size()-1].x - v[0].x;
998 ry = v[v.size()-1].y - v[0].y;
999 result += sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry);
1000 }
1001 return result;
1002}

1080class binMap
1081{
1082
1083 int ngroups;
1084 std::vector<std::vector<int> > column;
1085 std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int> > > row;
1086
1087 signed int firstUnmatched1(std::vector<int> v)
1088 {
1089 /***********************************************************
1090
1091 Returns an integer with the position of the first
1092 unmatched 1. If none is found, the function
1093 returns -1.
1094
1095 @v is the input std::vector to be searched for unmatched 1s
1096
1097 ***********************************************************/
1098
1099 signed int counter = 0;
1100 UINT i;
1101 for (i = 0; i < v.size(); i++)
1102 {
1103
1104 if (v[i] == 1)
1105 {
1106 counter++;
1107 if (counter > 0)
1108 return i;
1109 }
1110 else
1111 {
1112 counter--;
1113 }
1114 }
1115 return -1; // no unmatched @which
1116 }
1117
1118 signed int firstUnmatched0(std::vector<int> v)
1119 {
1120 /***********************************************************
1121
1122 Returns an integer with the position of the first
1123 unmatched 0. If none is found, the function
1124 returns -1.
1125
1126 @v is the input std::vector to be searched for unmatched 0s
1127
1128 ***********************************************************/
1129
1130 int counter;
1131 UINT i, j;
1132 bool ismatched = false;
1133 if (v.size() > 0){
1134 for (i = 0; i < v.size() - 1; i++)
1135 {
1136 counter = 0;
1137 if (v[i] == 0)
1138 {
1139 ismatched = false;
1140 for (j = i + 1; j < v.size(); j++)
1141 {
1142 if (v[j] == 0)
1143 {
1144 counter++;
1145 }
1146 else
1147 {
1148 counter--;
1149 }
1150 if (counter < 0)
1151 ismatched = true;
1152 }
1153 if (!ismatched)
1154 return i;
1155 }
1156 }
1157 if (v[v.size() - 1] == 0)
1158 return (v.size()-1);
1159 }
1160 return -1; // no unmatched @which
1161 }
1162 std::vector<std::vector<int> > getBranches(std::vector<int> v)
1163 {
1164 /***********************************************************
1165
1166 Returns a std::vector containing all of the branches derived
1167 from the input vector. These are obtained by changing to
1168 1 each 0 to the right of the last 1 if the resulting
1169 std::vector has no unmatched 1s. If there are no branches,
1170 the return std::vector is empty.
1171
1172 @v input binary vector
1173
1174 ***********************************************************/
1175
1176 UINT i;
1177 int last1=0;
1178 std::vector<int> tempV;
1179 std::vector<std::vector<int> > result;
1180 for (i = 0; i < v.size(); i++)
1181 {// Get last 1
1182 if (v[i]==1)
1183 last1 = i;
1184 }
1185 for (i = last1 + 1; i < v.size(); i++)
1186 {
1187 tempV = v;
1188 tempV[i] = 1;
1189 if (firstUnmatched1(tempV) == -1)
1190 {
1191 result.push_back(tempV);
1192 }
1193 }
1194 return result;
1195 }
1196
1197 void fillColumn(std::vector<int> v)
1198 {
1199 std::vector<int> result;
1200 int position = 0;
1201 result = v;
1202 position = firstUnmatched0(result);
1203 column.push_back(v);
1204 while (position != -1)
1205 {
1206 result[position] = 1;
1207 column.push_back(result);
1208 position = firstUnmatched0(result);
1209 }
1210 row.push_back(column);
1211 column.clear();
1212 }
1213
1214 void fillRow(std::vector<std::vector<int> > c)
1215 {
1216 UINT i;
1217 std::vector<std::vector<int> > tempc;
1218 for (i = 0; i < c.size(); i++)
1219 {
1220 fillColumn(c[i]);
1221 tempc = getBranches(c[i]);
1222 fillRow(tempc);
1223 }
1224 }
1225
1226public:
1227
1228 friend class borderLine;
1229
1230 binMap(int n)
1231 {
1232 std::vector<int> currentV;
1233 std::vector<std::vector<int> > currentC;
1234 ngroups = n;
1235 currentV = toBin(0, n);
1236 fillColumn(currentV);
1237 currentC = getBranches(currentV);
1238 fillRow(currentC);
1239 }

1269class decider{
1270 bool finish;
1271 bool canFinish;
1272 bool first;
1273 UINT cyclesWithoutImprovement;
1274 UINT finishAfter;
1275 float bestCompactness;
1276 UINT nAvg;
1277 UINT counter;
1278 UINT ncycles;
1279 UINT mincycles;
1280 float totalCompactness;
1281 float lastCompactness;
1282 //float bestUntie;
1283 float wRoom;
1284 bool keep;
1285public:
1286 void setConstants(UINT numberForAverage, UINT numberForStability, float wiggleRoom = 1, UINT minNumberOfCycles = 0){
1287 finish = false;
1288 canFinish = false;
1289 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
1290 nAvg = numberForAverage;
1291 finishAfter = numberForStability;
1292 counter = 0;
1293 totalCompactness = 0;
1294 first = true;
1295 keep = false;
1296 wRoom = wiggleRoom;
1297 mincycles = minNumberOfCycles;
1298 }
1299 void init(){
1300 finish = false;
1301 canFinish = false;
1302 first = true;
1303 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
1304 counter = 0;
1305 ncycles = 0;
1306 totalCompactness = 0;
1307 lastCompactness = 0;
1308 }
1309 void setCanFinish(){
1310 canFinish = true;
1311 if (finishAfter == 0){
1312 finish = true;
1313 }
1314 }
1315 bool keepState(){
1316 return keep;
1317 }
1318 void add(float comp){
1319 if (comp == 0){
1320 finish = true;
1321 }
1322 keep = false;
1323 ncycles++;
1324 if (first){
1325 first = false;
1326 counter++;
1327 bestCompactness = comp;
1328 lastCompactness = comp;
1329 }
1330 if (canFinish){
1331 if (finishAfter == 0){
1332 finish = true;
1333 }
1334 if (comp < (bestCompactness)){
1335 bestCompactness = comp;
1336 keep = true;
1337 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
1338 }
1339 else{
1340 cyclesWithoutImprovement++;
1341 if (cyclesWithoutImprovement > finishAfter){
1342 finish = true;
1343 }
1344 }
1345 }
1346 else{
1347 totalCompactness += comp;
1348 counter++;
1349 if (counter > nAvg){
1350 float newAvg = totalCompactness / ((float)(nAvg));
1351 if (newAvg > (lastCompactness / wRoom) && ncycles > mincycles){
1352 canFinish = true;
1353 }
1354 counter = 1;
1355 totalCompactness = 0;
1356 lastCompactness = newAvg;
1357 }
1358 }
1359 }
1360 UINT viewCounter(){
1361 return counter;
1362 }
1363 float viewLastComp(){
1364 return lastCompactness;
1365 }
1366 UINT viewCanFinish(){
1367 return (UINT) canFinish;
1368 }
1369 UINT viewCyclesWithoutImprovement(){
1370 return cyclesWithoutImprovement;
1371 }
1372
1373 bool finished(){
1374 bool result = finish;
1375 return result;
1376 }
1377

1785 UINT wgt = weights[i][1];
1786 if (wgt > maxw){
1787 maxw = wgt;
1788 }
1789 }
1790 for (UINT i = 0; i < weights.size(); i++){
1791 UINT reg = weights[i][0];
1792 UINT sz = weights[i][1];
1793 float r = 2 * sqrt(((float) sz) / ((float) maxw));
1794 point cpoint;
1795 cpoint.n = reg;
1796 cpoint.radius = 2 * sqrt(w[i] / maxw);;
1797 cpoint.setCustom(i);
1798 circRadii.push_back(r);
1799 cpoint.orig = sz;
1800 circles.push_back(cpoint);
1801 }
1802 for (UINT j = 0; j < circRadii.size(); j++){
1803 if (circRadii[j] > 0 && circRadii[j] < minCircRadius) minCircRadius = circRadii[j];
1804 if (circRadii[j] > 0 && circRadii[j] > maxRadius) maxRadius = circRadii[j];
1805 }

1857 void randomizeCircles(){
1858 UINT gstep = 1;
1859 UINT gridSize = (UINT) (sqrt(nregions()) + 2);
1860 if ((ngroups & 1) > 0){ // Odd number of groups
1861 gridSize = gridSize << 1;
1862 gstep = 2;
1863 }
1864
1865 //std::cout << "gridSize: " << gridSize << "\n";
1866 float xstep = internalScale.xSpan() / ((gridSize + 1));
1867 float ystep = xstep; //internalScale.ySpan() / (gridSize + 1);
1868 //std::cout << "xStep: " << internalScale.xSpan() << "\n";
1869 //std::cout << "yStep: " << ystep << "\n";
1870 std::vector<UINT> order;
1871 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
1872 order.push_back(i);
1873 }
1874 std::random_device rd;
1875 if (!fromSignature) seed = rd();
1876 std::mt19937 g(seed);
1877 shuffle(order.begin(), order.end(), g);
1878 UINT sy = 0; UINT sx = 0;
1879 std::uniform_real_distribution<float> dt(-1,1);
1880 for (UINT i = 0; i < 2; i++){
1881 float cx = (sx + 0.5) * xstep + internalScale.minX();
1882 float cy = (sy + 0.5) * ystep + internalScale.minY();
1883 sx += 1 + 2 * dt(g);
1884 sy += 1 + 2 * dt(g);
1885 if (i < order.size() && order[i] < circles.size()){
1886 circles[order[i]].x = cx;
1887 circles[order[i]].y = cy;
1888 }
1889 }
1890 for (UINT i = 3; i < circles.size(); i++){
1891 float cx = (sx + 0.5) * xstep + internalScale.minX();
1892 float cy = (sy + 0.5) * ystep + internalScale.minY();
1893 sx += gstep;
1894 if (sx > gridSize){
1895 sy++;
1896 sx = 0;
1897 }
1898 circles[order[i]].x = cx;
1899 circles[order[i]].y = cy;
1900 }
1901
1902 }

2020 point eqforce(point &p0, point &p1, float kattr = 5e-2f)
2021 {
2022 point result;
2023 float radius;
2024 float dx, dy;
2025 float fatt;
2026 float d;
2027 radius = 1.0 * (p0.radius + p1.radius);
2028 float maxrad = p0.radius;
2029 if (p1.radius > maxrad) maxrad = p1.radius;
2030 //radius *= 1.2;
2031 dx = p1.x - p0.x;
2032 dy = p1.y - p0.y;
2033 d = distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
2034 fatt = 0;
2035 if (d > maxrad) fatt = blSettings.sk * kattr * (d - radius);
2036 if (d < maxrad) fatt = -fatt;
2037 fatt /= twoPow(ngroups);
2038 result.fx = dx * fatt;
2039 result.fy = dy * fatt;
2040 p0.fx += result.fx;
2041 p1.fx -= result.fx;
2042 p0.fy += result.fy;
2043 p1.fy -= result.fy;
2044 return result;
2045 }

2047 point selforce(point &p0, point &p1, float kattr = 5e-3f, float radiusFactor = 0)
2048 {
2049 if (kattr == 0){
2050 kattr = 5e-3f;
2051 }
2052 if (p1.radius == 0 || p0.radius == 0){
2053 return p0;
2054 }
2055 float repulsion = blSettings.sk * kattr * 5;
2056 point result;
2057 UINT n1 = p0.custom;
2058 UINT n2 = p1.custom;
2059 float factor = (float) getRelationships(n1, n2) + 1 - universals;
2060 float radius = radiusFactor * (p0.radius + p1.radius);
2061 //radius *= 1.2;
2062 float dx = p1.x - p0.x;
2063 float dy = p1.y - p0.y;
2064 float d = distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
2065 if (d == 0){
2066 p0.x -= 1;
2067 p0.y -= 1;
2068 p1.x += 1;
2069 p1.y += 1;
2070 d = distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
2071 }
2072 float fatt = repulsion;
2073 if (d > radius) fatt = (factor*factor) * blSettings.sk * kattr * (d-radius) - repulsion;
2074 //if (d < radius) fatt = -blSettings.sk * kattr * (d - radius);
2075 result.fx = dx * fatt/d;
2076 result.fy = dy * fatt/d;
2077 potential += fatt;
2078 p0.fx += result.fx;
2079 p1.fx -= result.fx;
2080 p0.fy += result.fy;
2081 p1.fy -= result.fy;
2082 return result;
2083 }

2545 float getArea(){

2575 for (UINT j = i + 1; j < circles.size(); j++){
2576 if (circles[j].radius > 0){

2589 UINT nextLeftmostPoint(UINT ngroup, UINT n1, UINT n2){
2590 point anchor = circles[n1];
2591 if (n1 == n2){
2592 anchor.x -= 1;
2593 }
2594 groupIterator git(circles, ngroup, n2);
2595 git.nxt();
2596 bool first = true;
2597 ccwangle best(anchor, circles[n2], anchor);
2598 UINT result = git.val();
2599 while (!git.isFinished()){
2600 UINT n3 = git.val();
2601 if (n3 != n2){
2602 ccwangle test(anchor, circles[n2], circles[n3]);
2603 if (first || best < test){
2604 first = false;
2605 best = test;
2606 result = n3;
2607 }
2608 }
2609 git.nxt();
2610 }
2611 return result;
2612 }

2712 else{

2714

2809 std::vector<point> getSetBoundaries(UINT groups, float air = 0, bool onlyCircles = false){

2814 //i = ci.nxt();

2846 result[0].x = bl[k][j].x;

2848 if (bl[k][j].y < result[0].y){
2849 result[0].y = bl[k][j].y;

2852 result[1].x = bl[k][j].x;

2855 result[1].y = bl[k][j].y;
2856 }
2857 }
2858 }
2859 }
2860 }
2861 result[0].x -= air;
2862 result[0].y -= air;
2863 result[1].x += air;
2864 result[1].y += air;
2865 return result;

3040 std::vector<UINT> sampleUINT(std::vector<UINT> from, UINT n, std::mt19937 *gen){
3041 UINT nc = from.size() - 1;
3042 std::vector<UINT> cp = from;
3043 std::vector<UINT> result;
3044 std::set<UINT> offsets;
3045 for (UINT i = 0; i < n; i++){
3046 std::uniform_int_distribution<UINT> distrib(0, nc);
3047 UINT ni = distrib(*gen);
3048 std::set<UINT>::iterator it;
3049 for (it = offsets.begin(); it != offsets.end(); it++){
3050 UINT v = *it;
3051 if (v <= ni){
3052 ni++;
3053 }
3054 }
3055 offsets.insert(ni);
3056 result.push_back(from[ni]);
3057 nc--;
3058 }
3059 return result;
3060 }

3066
3074 float MHCompact(){
3075 UINT nstep = 2; // Number of circles exchanged in each step
3076 UINT maxSteps = 100000;
3077 std::random_device rd; // Will be used to obtain a seed for the random number engine
3078 std::mt19937 gen(rd()); // Standard mersenne_twister_engine seeded with rd()
3079 std::uniform_real_distribution<float> alpha(0.0, 1.0);
3080 UINT cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
3081 float bestCompactness = compactness();
3082 std::vector<UINT> existingCircles = ncircles();
3083 UINT counter = 0;
3084 while (cyclesWithoutImprovement < 1000 && counter < maxSteps){
3085 std::vector<UINT> exch = sampleUINT(existingCircles, nstep, &gen);
3086 UINT ci = exch[0];
3087 UINT cj = exch[1];
3088 tolog("Exchanging " + toString(ci) + " with " + toString(cj) + "\n");
3089 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3090 float newCompactness = compactness();
3091 tolog("Old comp: " + toString(bestCompactness) + "\tNew comp: " + toString(newCompactness) + "\n");
3092 if (newCompactness < bestCompactness){
3093 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
3094 bestCompactness = newCompactness;
3095 }
3096 else{
3097 float decd = alpha(gen);
3098 float rtio = bestCompactness / newCompactness;
3099 tolog("Decider: " + toString(decd) + ", " + "Ration: " + toString(rtio) + "\n");
3100 if (decd > rtio){
3101 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3102 tolog("Bailed\n");
3103 }
3104 cyclesWithoutImprovement++;
3105 }
3106 counter++;
3107 }
3108 return bestCompactness;

3111 float MHCrosses(){
3112 UINT nstep = 2; // Number of circles exchanged in each step
3113 UINT maxSteps = 10000;
3114 std::random_device rd; // Will be used to obtain a seed for the random number engine
3115 std::mt19937 gen(rd()); // Standard mersenne_twister_engine seeded with rd()
3116 std::uniform_real_distribution<float> alpha(0.0, 1.0);
3117 UINT cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
3118 fixTopology();
3119 float bestCrossings = countCrossings();
3120 std::vector<UINT> existingCircles = ncircles();
3121 UINT counter = 0;
3122 while (cyclesWithoutImprovement < 500 && counter < maxSteps){
3123 std::vector<UINT> exch = sampleUINT(existingCircles, nstep, &gen);
3124 UINT ci = exch[0];
3125 UINT cj = exch[1];
3126 tolog("Exchanging " + toString(ci) + " with " + toString(cj) + "\n");
3127 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3128 fixTopology();
3129 if (checkTopol()){
3130 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3131 }
3132 else{
3133 float newCrossings = countCrossings();
3134 tolog("Old cross: " + toString(bestCrossings) + "\tNew cross: " + toString(newCrossings) + "\n");
3135 if (newCrossings < bestCrossings){
3136 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
3137 bestCrossings = newCrossings;
3138 }
3139 else{
3140 float decd = alpha(gen);
3141 float rtio = bestCrossings / newCrossings;
3142 tolog("Decider: " + toString(decd) + ", " + "Ration: " + toString(rtio) + "\n");
3143 if (decd > rtio){
3144 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3145 tolog("Bailed\n");
3146 }
3147 cyclesWithoutImprovement++;
3148 }
3149 counter++;
3150 }
3151 }
3152 return bestCrossings;
3153 }

3170 UINT furthestPoint(){
3171 UINT result = 0;
3172 float best = 0;
3173 bool first = true;
3174 bool resetOpt = true;
3175 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
3176 if (circles[i].radius > 0){
3177 float val = 0;
3178 if ((circles[i].flags & DO_NOT_OPTIMIZE) == 0){
3179 resetOpt = false;
3180 for (UINT j = 0; j < circles.size(); j++){
3181 if (i != j){
3182 UINT rel = getRelationships(i, j);
3183 if (rel > 0){
3184 float dsq = sqDistance(circles[i], circles[j]);
3185 val += log(rel) + log(dsq);
3186 //tolog(toString(val) + "\n");
3187 }
3188 }
3189 }
3190 if ((first) || (val > best)){
3191 result = i;
3192 best = val;
3193 first = false;
3194 }
3195 }
3196 }
3197 }
3198 //tolog(_L_ + circles[result].croack());
3199 if (resetOpt){
3200 resetOptimize();
3201 }
3202 circles[result].flags = setFlag(circles[result].flags, DO_NOT_OPTIMIZE);
3203 return result;
3204 }

3373 point spring(point &p0, point &p1, float dampen = 0, float springK = -1)
3374 {
3375 if (springK < 0){
3376 springK = blSettings.sk;
3377 }
3378 point result;
3379 float dx = p1.x - p0.x;
3380 float dy = p1.y - p0.y;
3381 result.fx = springK * dx;
3382 result.fy = springK * dy;
3383 p0.fx += result.fx - dampen * p0.vx * p0.vx * p0.vx;
3384 p1.fx -= result.fx + dampen * p1.vx * p1.vx * p1.vx;
3385 p0.fy += result.fy - dampen * p0.vy * p0.vy * p0.vy;
3386 p1.fy -= result.fy + dampen * p1.vy * p1.vy * p1.vy;
3387 return result;
3388 }

3601 point rope(point &circ, point &p0, point &p1)
3602 {
3603 float a, b;
3604 float d;
3605 point result;
3606 point zero;
3607 point virt;
3608 float d0, d1;
3609 a = (p1.y - p0.y)/(p1.x - p0.x);
3610 b = p0.y - a * p0.x;
3611 virt.x = ((circ.x + a*circ.y - a * b)/(a*a + 1));
3612 virt.y = (a * circ.x + a*a*circ.y + b)/(a*a + 1);
3613 d0 = distance(p0.x, p0.y, virt.x, virt.y) /
3614 distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
3615 d1 = distance(p1.x, p1.y, virt.x, virt.y) /
3616 distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
3617 float td = d0 + d1;
3618 float rd = d0 / td;
3619 virt.vx = p0.vx + (p1.vx-p0.vx) * rd;
3620 virt.fx = p0.fx + (p1.fx-p0.fx) * rd;
3621 virt.vy = p0.vy + (p1.vy-p0.vy) * rd;
3622 virt.fy = p0.fy + (p1.fy-p0.fy) * rd;
3623 virt.mass = p0.mass;
3624 d = distance(circ.x, circ.y, virt.x, virt.y);
3625 if (d < circ.radius && isInside(p0, p1, virt))
3626 {
3627 result = contact(circ, virt);
3628 p0.fx = d1 * virt.fx * rd;
3629 p0.fy = d1 * virt.fy * rd;
3630 p1.fx = d0 * virt.fx * rd;
3631 p1.fy = d0 * virt.fy * rd;
3632 //attention(p0.x, p0.y, p0.x+1e-3*p0.fx, p0.y+1e-3*p0.fy);
3633 //attention(p1.x, p1.y, p1.x+1e-3*p1.fx, p1.y+1e-3*p1.fy);
3634 //Sleep(100);
3635 return result;
3636 }
3637 else
3638 {
3639 return zero;
3640 }
3641 }

3891 int closestToSurf(UINT i, UINT j){
3892 // Get the closest circle to a line point
3893 UINT result = 0;

3895 while (circles[result].radius == 0 && result < circles.size()){
3896 result++;
3897 }
3898 float mindist = distance(P.x, P.y, circles[result].x, circles[result].y) - circles[result].radius;
3899 UINT k = result;
3900 while (k < circles.size()){
3901 float dst = distance(P.x, P.y, circles[k].x, circles[k].y) - circles[k].radius;
3902 if (dst < mindist){
3903 mindist = dst;
3904 result = circles[k].n;
3905 }
3906 k++;
3907 }
3908 return result;
3909 }

4338
4339 point getCross(point p1, point p2, point p3, point p4){
4340 point result;
4341 if (std::max(p1.x, p2.x) >= std::min(p3.x, p4.x) &&
4342 std::max(p1.y, p2.y) >= std::min(p3.y, p4.y) &&
4343 std::min(p1.x, p2.x) <= std::max(p3.x, p4.x) &&
4344 std::min(p1.y, p2.y) <= std::max(p3.y, p4.y)){
4345 if (p2.x == p1.x){
4346 result.x = p1.x;
4347 result.y = p3.y + (result.x - p3.x) * (p4.y - p3.y) / (p4.x - p3.x);
4348 }
4349 else if (p4.x == p3.x){
4350 result.x = p3.x;
4351 result.y = p1.y + (result.x - p1.x) * (p2.y - p1.y) / (p2.x - p1.x);
4352 }
4353 else{
4354 float m1 = (p2.y - p1.y) / (p2.x - p1.x);
4355 float m3 = (p4.y - p3.y) / (p4.x - p3.x);
4356 result.x = (p3.y - m3 * p3.x - p1.y + m1 * p1.x) / (m1 - m3);
4357 result.y = p1.y + m1 * (result.x - p1.x);
4358 }
4359 }
4360 return result;
4361 }
4362
4374 crossResult cross(point p1, point p2, point p3, point p4){
4375 crossResult result = doesnotcross;
4376 if (std::max(p1.x, p2.x) >= std::min(p3.x, p4.x) &&
4377 std::max(p1.y, p2.y) >= std::min(p3.y, p4.y) &&
4378 std::min(p1.x, p2.x) <= std::max(p3.x, p4.x) &&
4379 std::min(p1.y, p2.y) <= std::max(p3.y, p4.y)){
4380 if (p1 == p3 || p2 == p3){
4381 return crosses;
4382 }
4383 if (p2 == p4 || p1 == p4){
4384 return crosses;
4385 }
4386 tangent t1 = tangent(p1, p3);
4387 tangent t2 = tangent(p3, p2);
4388 tangent t3 = tangent(p2, p4);
4389 tangent t4 = tangent(p4, p1);
4390 t2.rotate(t1);
4391 t3.rotate(t1);
4392 t4.rotate(t1);
4393 tangent tz = tangent(-1, 0);
4394 if (t2 == tz){
4395 result = doesnotcross;
4396 }
4397 else if (t3 == t4){
4398 result = cont;
4399 }
4400 else{
4401 if (((t2 <= t3) && (t3 <= t4)) ||
4402 ((t3 <= t2) && (t4 <= t3))){
4403 result = crosses;
4404 }
4405 }
4406 }
4407 return result;
4408 }

4433 bl = result;

4729UINT getRelationships(UINT o, UINT t){
4730 UINT i = std::min(o, t);
4731 UINT j = std::max(o, t);
4732 if (i == j){
4733 return 0;
4734 }
4735 UINT r = 0;
4736 UINT N = circles.size();
4737 i++;
4738 UINT row = ((2*i-2) * N - i * i + i) / 2;
4739 r = row + j - i;
4740 return relationships[r];
4741}

4802std::vector<std::vector<UINT>> nextlevel(UINT n, std::vector<std::vector<UINT>> vtp){
4803 std::vector<std::vector<UINT>> result;
4804 for (UINT i = 0; i < vtp.size(); i++){
4805 std::vector<UINT> cvec = vtp[i];
4806 std::vector<UINT> rest;
4807 for (UINT k = 0; k < n; k++){
4808 bool incl = true;
4809 for (UINT v : cvec){
4810 if (k == v){
4811 incl = false;
4812 }
4813 }
4814 if (incl){
4815 rest.push_back(k);
4816 }
4817 }
4818 UINT nr = rest.size();
4819 if (nr > 1){
4820 for (UINT j = 0; j < nr - 1; j++){
4821 for (UINT k = j + 1; k < nr; k++){
4822 UINT n1 = rest[j];
4823 UINT n2 = rest[k];
4824 std::vector<UINT> t = {n1, n2};
4825 t.insert(t.begin(), cvec.begin(), cvec.end());
4826 result.push_back(t);
4827 }
4828 }
4829 }
4830 }
4831 return result;
4832}

4835std::vector<std::vector<UINT>> exMinimize(UINT maxlevels = 0){
4836 std::vector<std::vector<UINT>> pairs;
4837 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size() - 1; i++){
4838 for (UINT j = i + 1; j < circles.size(); j++){
4839 std::vector<UINT> pr;
4840 pr.push_back(i);
4841 pr.push_back(j);
4842 pairs.push_back(pr);
4843 }
4844 }
4845 std::vector<std::vector<UINT>> p = pairs;
4846 for (UINT level = 0; level < maxlevels; level++){
4847 std::vector<std::vector<UINT>> nl = nextlevel(circles.size(), p);
4848 pairs.insert(pairs.end(), nl.begin(), nl.end());
4849 p.clear();
4850 p = nl;
4851 }
4852 return pairs;
4853}

4855bool exTest(std::vector<std::vector<UINT>> combinations){
4856 std::vector<UINT> bestCombination;
4857 UINT bestCross = (UINT) countCrossings();
4858 float bestComp = compactness();
4859 for (std::vector<UINT> comb : combinations){
4860 for (UINT i = 0; i < comb.size(); i = i + 2){
4861 UINT p1 = comb[i];
4862 UINT p2 = comb[i + 1];
4863 swapCoords(p1, p2);
4864 }
4865 UINT nc = (UINT) countCrossings();
4866 float comp = compactness();
4867 if (nc < bestCross || (nc == bestCross && comp < bestComp)){
4868 bestCross = nc;
4869 bestComp = comp;
4870 bestCombination = comb;
4871 }
4872 for (UINT i = 0; i < comb.size(); i = i + 2){
4873 UINT p1 = comb[i];
4874 UINT p2 = comb[i + 1];
4875 swapCoords(p1, p2);
4876 }
4877 }
4878 for (UINT i = 0; i < bestCombination.size(); i = i + 2){
4879 UINT p1 = bestCombination[i];
4880 UINT p2 = bestCombination[i + 1];
4881 swapCoords(p1, p2);
4882 }
4883 return true;
4884}

4985 point place(scale s, point m)
4986 {
4987 point r;
4988 scale tempScale;
4989 tempScale.initScale();
4990 float offset;
4991 float Scale;
4992 if (s.ratio() <= internalScale.ratio())
4993 {
4994 offset = s.xSpan() - s.ySpan() / internalScale.ratio();
4995 offset /= 2;
4996 tempScale.setMinX(offset + s.minX());
4997 tempScale.setMaxX(s.maxX() - offset);
4998 tempScale.setMinY(s.minY());
4999 tempScale.setMaxY(s.maxY());
5000 }
5001 else
5002 {
5003 offset = s.ySpan() - internalScale.ratio() * s.xSpan();
5004 offset /= 2;
5005 tempScale.setMinX(s.minX());
5006 tempScale.setMaxX(s.maxX());
5007 tempScale.setMinY(offset + s.minY());
5008 tempScale.setMaxY(s.maxY() - offset);
5009 }
5010 r.x = m.x - internalScale.minX();
5011 r.y = m.y - internalScale.minY();
5012 r.x /= internalScale.xSpan();
5013 r.y /= internalScale.ySpan();
5014 r.x *= tempScale.xSpan();
5015 r.y *= tempScale.ySpan();
5016 r.x += tempScale.minX();
5017 r.y += tempScale.minY();
5018 Scale = tempScale.xSpan() / internalScale.xSpan();
5019 r.radius = Scale * m.radius;
5020 return r;
5021 }

5024 rgb toRGB(int color, int max)

5028 result.red = result.red * max / 0xFF;
5029 result.green = (0x0000FF00 & color)/0x100;
5030 result.green = result.green * max / 0xFF;
5031 result.blue = (0x000000FF & color);
5032 result.blue = result.blue * max / 0xFF;
5033 return result;
5034 }

5079 float minCircDist(){
5080 UINT flg = twoPow(ngroups) - 1;
5081 groupIterator ci(circles, 0, 0, flg);
5082 UINT fst = ci.val();
5083 UINT scnd = ci.nxt();
5084 float r = sqDistance(circles[fst], circles[scnd]);
5085 ci = groupIterator(circles, 0, 0, flg);
5086 groupIterator ci2(circles, 0, 0, flg);
5087 while (!ci.isFinished()){
5088 UINT v = ci.val();
5089 ci2.reset(v);
5090 while (!ci2.isFinished()){
5091 UINT w = ci2.nxt();
5092 if (v != w){
5093 float nr = sqDistance(circles[v], circles[w]);
5094 if (nr < r){
5095 r = nr;
5096 }
5097 }
5098 }
5099 ci.nxt();
5100 }
5101
5102 float result = sqrt(r);
5103 return result;
5104 }

5120 for (UINT i = 0; i < sceneTranslator.size(); i++){
5121 if (sceneTranslator[i] > 0){
5122 std::vector<UINT> t;
5123 t.push_back(sceneTranslator[i]);
5124 t.push_back(i);
5125 cs.push_back(t);
5126 }
5127 }
5128 gp.clear();
5129 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
5130 for (UINT k = 0; k < bl[i].size(); k++){
5131 for (UINT j = 0; j < circles.size(); j++){
5132 UINT mask = 1 << i;
5133 if (circles[j].radius > 0 && ((circles[j].n & mask) > 0)){
5134 UINT tn = 0;
5135 UINT counter = 0;
5136 bool found = false;
5137 while (!found && counter < cs.size()){
5138 std::vector<UINT> tmp = cs[counter];
5139 if (tmp[0] == circles[j].n){
5140 found = true;
5141 tn = tmp[1];
5142 }
5143 }
5144 if (!found){
5145 setError("Error in scene translation");
5146 }
5147 gp.push_back({counter, tn});
5148 }
5149 }
5150 }
5151 }
5152 /*for (UINT i = 0; i < gp.size(); i++){
5153 vlog(gp[i]);
5154 }
5155 exit(0);*/
5156 blSettings.part = true;
5157 tosolve.setGravityPartitions(gp);
5158 }

5160 void centerScene(){
5161 float xmax = internalScale.maxX();
5162 float xmin = internalScale.minX();
5163 float ymax = internalScale.maxY();
5164 float ymin = internalScale.minY();
5165 float deltax = (xmax + xmin) / 2;
5166 float deltay = (ymax + ymin) / 2;
5167 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
5168 for (UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
5169 bl[i][j].x -= deltax;
5170 bl[i][j].y -= deltay;
5171 internalScale.addToScale(bl[i][j]);
5172 }
5173 }
5174 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
5175 if (circles[i].radius > 0){
5176 circles[i].x -= deltax;
5177 circles[i].y -= deltay;
5178 internalScale.addToScale(circles[i]);
5179 }
5180 }
5181 resetScale();
5182 }

5184 void attachScene(){
5185 float springK = scConstants.K;
5186 UINT cnt = 0;
5187 tosolve.clearScene();
5188 tosolve.setBackgroundGravity();
5189 tosolve.setRodStiffness(1e5);
5190 sceneTranslator.clear();
5191 pairDistances.clear();
5192 UINT level = 1;
5193 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
5194 UINT lp = cnt;
5195 for (UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
5196 //bl[i][j].flags = bl[i][j].flags | INGRAVID;
5197 bl[i][j].flags = bl[i][j].flags | GHOST;
5198 tosolve.addPointP(&(bl[i][j]));
5199 sceneTranslator.push_back(bl[i][j].n);
5200 tosolve.addLink(cnt + lp, cnt + j, springK);
5201 lp = j;
5202 pairDistances.push_back(cushion * (float) level);
5203 }
5204 tosolve.addLink(cnt + lp, cnt, springK);
5205 cnt += lp + 1;
5206 level++;
5207 }
5208 level *= 2;
5209 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
5210 if (circles[i].radius > 0){
5211 tosolve.addPointP(&(circles[i]));
5212 sceneTranslator.push_back(circles[i].n);
5213 pairDistances.push_back(cushion * (float) level);
5214 }
5215 }
5216 tosolve.setCushions(pairDistances);
5217 if (blSettings.part){
5218 //setGravityPartitions();
5219 }
5220 tosolve.setPseudoGravity(true);
5221 }

5230 if (checkTopol()){
5231 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
5232 for (UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
5233 internalScale.addToScale(bl[i][j]);

5264 void doubleThePoints(){
5265 if (doublings < maxdoublings){
5266 std::vector<std::vector<point>> newbl;
5267 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
5268 std::vector<point> tbl;
5269 for (UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
5270 point p = bl[i][j];
5271 point n = bl[i][0];
5272 if (j < (bl[i].size() - 1)){
5273 n = bl[i][j+1];
5274 }
5275 point newp(p);
5276 newp.x = (p.x + n.x) / 2;
5277 newp.y = (p.y + n.y) / 2;
5278 tbl.push_back(p);
5279 tbl.push_back(newp);
5280 }
5281 newbl.push_back(tbl);
5282 }
5283 bl.clear();
5284 for (UINT i = 0; i < newbl.size(); i++){
5285 bl.push_back({});
5286 for (UINT j = 0; j < newbl[i].size(); j++){
5287 bl[i].push_back(newbl[i][j].clone());
5288 }
5289 }
5290 attachScene();
5291 doublings++;
5292 }
5293 }

5295 void scSolve(){
5296 blSettings.dt = tosolve.solve(blSettings.dt, resetV);
5297 bool incorrect = checkTopol();
5298 while (incorrect){
5299 restorePrevState();
5300 evaluation.init();
5301 incorrect = checkTopol();
5302 if (incorrect){
5303 setError("Topol problems at start of simulation");
5304 //std::cout << croack() << std::endl;
5305 return;
5306 }
5307 //tolog(_L_ + "Bad topol\n");
5308 udt.report();
5309 if (blSettings.dt < blSettings.mindt){
5310 if (doublings < maxdoublings){
5311 doubleThePoints();
5312 }
5313 else{
5314 tolog(_L_ + "Cannot solve topol problems\n");
5315 writeSVG("error.svg");
5316 setError("Cannot solve topol problems");
5317 }
5318 }
5319 blSettings.dt = udt.cdt();
5320 //tolog(_L_ + "Bad topol: " + toString(udt.cdt()) + "\n");
5321 tosolve.solve(blSettings.dt, resetV);
5322 }
5323 if (blCounter == 0){
5324 setPrevState();
5325 }
5326 if (deciderCounter.isMax()){
5327 setPrevState();
5328 udt.poke();
5329 blSettings.dt = udt.cdt();
5330 }
5331 if (blSettings.optimize && keepDistCounter.isMax()){
5332 keepDist(avgStartDist);
5333 if (checkTopol()){
5334 writeSVG("error.svg");
5335 listOutsiders();
5336 tolog(_L_ + "Break on KeepDist\n");
5337 restorePrevState();
5338 }
5339 else{
5340 setSecureState();
5341 }
5342 }
5343 resetScale();
5344 resetCircleRadius();
5345 float d = (this->*currentMeasure)();
5346 evaluation.add(d);
5347 //float mfsq = std::log10(tosolve.getMaxFsq());
5348 //float mvsq = std::log10(tosolve.getMaxVsq());
5349 //float mdsq = std::log10(tosolve.getMaxDsq());
5350 displayFloat("EVALUATE", d);
5351 displayFloat("LASTEVALUATE", evaluation.viewLastComp());
5352 if (blSettings.optimize){
5353 if (evaluation.keepState() && sensible()){
5354 setBestSoFar();
5355 }
5356 }
5357 displayFloat("DT", blSettings.dt);
5358 displayFloat("SIMTIME", tosolve.simTime());
5359 //displayFloat("MAXV", mvsq);
5360 //displayFloat("MAXF", mfsq);
5361 displayUINT("COUNTER", evaluation.viewCounter());
5362 displayUINT("CANFINISH", evaluation.viewCanFinish());
5363 displayUINT("CWI", evaluation.viewCyclesWithoutImprovement());
5364 //displayUINT("DECIDER", deciderCounter);
5365 blCounter++;
5366 deciderCounter++;
5367 keepDistCounter++;
5368 blSettings.ncycles++;
5369 }

5521 void restoreBl(std::string dataFile){
5522 //loadSignature(signature);
5523 std::istringstream vFile;
5524 std::string line;
5525 vFile.str(dataFile);
5526 bool sane = true;
5527 std::string errorstr;
5528 std::vector<std::vector<point>>newbl;
5529 newbl.clear();
5530 std::string all;
5531 for (std::string line; std::getline(vFile, line);){
5532 all += exchangeChar(line, '\n', 0x00);
5533 }
5534 std::istringstream sline(all);
5535 std::string el;
5536 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5537 if (el == "F"){
5538 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5539 //std::cout << el;
5540 currentStep = (UINT) atoi(el.c_str());
5541 }
5542 else{
5543 sane = false;
5544 errorstr += "Failed first step. ";
5545 }
5546 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5547 if (el == "L"){
5548 while (el != "" && el != "C"){
5549 if (el == "L"){
5550 newbl.push_back({});
5551 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5552 }
5553 UINT ind = newbl.size() - 1;
5554 while (el != "" && el != "C" && el != "L"){
5555 float cx = std::atof(el.c_str());
5556 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5557 float cy = std::atof(el.c_str());
5558 point p(cx, cy);
5559 newbl[ind].push_back(p);
5560 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5561 }
5562 }
5563 }
5564 std::vector<point> newcircles;
5565 if (el == "C"){ // (There should be a fixed number of circles.) Not anymore!
5566 while (el != "S"){
5567 point p;
5568 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5569 if (el != "S"){
5570 p.x = std::atof(el.c_str());
5571 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5572 p.y = std::atof(el.c_str());
5573 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5574 p.radius = std::atof(el.c_str());
5575 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5576 p.n = (UINT) std::atoi(el.c_str());
5577 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5578 p.orig = (UINT) std::atoi(el.c_str());
5579 newcircles.push_back(p);
5580 }
5581 }
5582 }
5583 else{
5584 sane = false;
5585 errorstr += "Failed circles. ";
5586 }
5587 //std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5588 if (sane){
5589 nvenn sel = nvenn();
5590 for (UINT i = 0; i < newbl.size(); i++){
5591 if (el == "S" || el == ""){
5592 std::string sn;
5593 std::unordered_set<std::string> els;
5594 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5595 sn = el;
5596 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5597 while (el != "" && el != "S"){
5598 els.insert(el);
5599 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5600 }
5601 sel.addSet(sn, sel.asVector(els));
5602 }
5603 else{
5604 sane = false;
5605 }
5606 }
5607 std::string tovenn = sel.getCode();
5608 std::vector<std::string> setNames = getNames(tovenn);
5609 std::vector<std::vector<UINT>> tw = getWeights(tovenn);
5610 init(setNames, tw);
5611 setElements = sel.clone();
5612 savedState.bl_secure.clear();
5613 savedState.bl_old10.clear();
5614 bl.clear();
5615 circles.clear();
5616 for (UINT i = 0; i < newcircles.size(); i++){
5617 circles.push_back(newcircles[i].clone());
5618 internalScale.addToScale(newcircles[i]);
5619 }
5620 for (UINT i = 0; i < newbl.size(); i++){
5621 bl.push_back({});
5622 for (UINT j = 0; j < newbl[i].size(); j++){
5623 bl[i].push_back(newbl[i][j].clone());
5624 }
5625 }
5626 attachScene();
5627 blSettings.doCheckTopol = true;
5628 blSettings.smoothSVG = true;
5629 resetScale();
5630 }
5631 else{
5632 setError("Malformed save string: " + errorstr);
5633 //std::cout << "insane" << std::endl;
5634 }
5635
5636 }

5852 svg.addText(" font-size: ");

5857 svg.addLine(" }");

5867 }
5868 svg.addLine("]]>");
5869 svg.addLine("</style>");
5870 std::string nc = bool2string(blSettings.signalEnd);
5871 /* This softens the lines*/
5872 if (blSettings.doCheckTopol){
5873 if (blSettings.smoothSVG == true){
5874 for (i = 0; i < ngroups; i++){
5875 fileText mypath(" ", 80);

5878 mypath.addLine(cpath);
5879 for (j = 0; j < (bl[i].size()); j++){
5880 point prev = place(svgScale, bl[i][prevPoint(i, j)]);
5881 point curr = place(svgScale, bl[i][j]);
5882 point next = place(svgScale, bl[i][nextPoint(i, j)]);
5883 point next2 = place(svgScale, bl[i][nextPoint(i, nextPoint(i, j))]);

5886 cpath = " C " + coord(ctrlfst.x) + " " + coord(ctrlfst.y) + " " +
5887 coord(ctrlsec.x) + " " + coord(ctrlsec.y) + " " +
5888 coord(next.x) + " " + coord(next.y);
5889 mypath.addLine(cpath);
5890 }

5892 svg.addLine("<path d=\"" + mypath.getText() + " Z\" />");
5893 svg.addLine("</symbol>");
5894 }
5895 } else{
5896 /* This does not */
5897 for (i = 0; i < ngroups; i++){
5898 point nxt = place(svgScale, bl[i][0]);
5899 std::string cpath = "M " + coord(nxt.x) + " " + coord(nxt.y);
5900 for (j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
5901 nxt = place(svgScale, bl[i][j]);
5902 cpath += " L " + coord(nxt.x) + " " + coord(nxt.y);
5903 }
5904 svg.addLine("<symbol id=\"bl" + num(i) + cuid + "\">");
5905 svg.addLine("<path d=\"" + cpath + " Z\" />");
5906 svg.addLine("</symbol>");
5907 }
5908 }
5909 }
5910 svg.addLine("</defs>");
5911 //svg.addLine("<!-- signature: " + signature + " -->");
5912 svg.addLine("<desc>" + join((std::string)";", dataDisplay) + "</desc>");
5913 std::string bldesc = saveBl();
5914 svg.addLine("<desc id='result" + cuid + "'>" + bldesc + "</desc>");
5915 //restoreBl(bldesc);
5916 svg.addLine("<rect width=\"700\" height=\"500\" style=\"fill:#fff;stroke-width:0\" />");
5917
5918 // Add fills
5919 if (blSettings.doCheckTopol){
5920 for (i = 0; i < ngroups; i++){
5921 svg.addLine("<use class=\"p" + num(i) + cuid + " borderLine" + cuid + "\" xlink:href=\"#bl" + num(i) + cuid + "\"/>");
5922 }
5923 // Add strokes
5924 for (i = 0; i < ngroups; i++){
5925 svg.addLine("<use class=\"q" + num(i) + cuid + " outLine" + cuid + "\" xlink:href=\"#bl" + num(i) + cuid + "\"/>");
5926 }
5927 }
5928 for (i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
5929 //printf("%d\n", i);

5932 //printf("%.4f, %.4f, %.4f\n", svgtemp.x, sc.minX, sc.maxX);
5933 if (svgtemp.x > svgScale.minX() && svgtemp.x < svgScale.maxX()){
5934 std::string clss = "circle" + cuid;

5938 tst = vformat("<circle onclick=\"fromCircle(%u)\" class=\"%s\" cx=\"%.4f\" cy=\"%.4f\" r=\"%.4f\" />", circles[i].n, clss.c_str(), svgtemp.x,
5939 svgtemp.y, svgtemp.radius);

5942 float deltaY = -fsize / 3;

5944 deltaY = fsize / 2;

5946 //tst = vformat("<text class=\"tLabel\" x=\"%.2f\" y=\"%.2f\">%s</text>", svgtemp.x, svgtemp.y - 4*fsize/2, labels[i].c_str());
5947 //svg.addLine(tst);
5948 tst = vformat("<text class=\"nLabel%s\" x=\"%.2f\" y=\"%.2f\">%g</text>", cuid.c_str(), svgtemp.x, svgtemp.y - deltaY, circles[i].orig);
5949 svg.addLine(tst);
5950
5951 }
5952 // Belongs to
5953 if (svgParams.showRegionNumbers){

5955 std::vector<std::string> blongs;

5966 deltaY = fsize / 2;
5967 }
5968 std::string t = vformat("<text class=\"belong%s\" x=\"%.2f\" y=\"%.2f\">(%s)</text>", cuid.c_str(), svgtemp.x, svgtemp.y + deltaY, bgs.c_str());
5969 svg.addLine(t);
5970 }
5971 }
5972 }
5973 }
5974 // Legend
5975 float cx = 500.0f;

5977 float rw = 30.0f;

5979 float dy = 40.0f;
5980 float dx = 40.0f;
5981 for (UINT l = 0; l < ngroups; l++){
5982 std::string g = groups[l];

5990 svg.addLine(addRect);
5991 svg.addLine(addOut);
5992 svg.addLine(addLegend);
5993 cy += dy;
5994 }
5995 if (debug.size() > 0){
5996 /*for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
5997 for (UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
5998 point nxt = place(svgScale, bl[i][j]);
5999 if ((bl[i][j].flags & DELME) > 0){
6000 std::string tcuid = "spcircle" + cuid;
6001 std::string tmp = vformat("<circle class=\"%s\" cx=\"%.4f\" cy=\"%.4f\" r=\"2\" />", tcuid.c_str(), nxt.x, nxt.y);
6002 svg.addLine(tmp);
6003 }
6004 }
6005 }*/
6006 for (UINT i = 0; i < debug.size(); i++){

6011 }

6013 }

6018 fileText toPS()
6019 {
6020 fileText pstext;
6021 std::string tst;
6022 UINT i, j;
6023 point pstemp;
6024 scale ps;
6025 ps.initScale();
6026 ps.setMinX(72.0f);
6027 ps.setMinY(72.0f);
6028 ps.setMaxX(551.0f);
6029 ps.setMaxY(721.0f);
6030
6031 // Postscript header
6032 pstext.addLine(" ");
6033 pstext.addLine("%!PS-Adobe-2.0");
6034 pstext.addLine(" ");
6035 pstext.addLine("/scale 1 def");
6036 pstext.addLine("/ury 0 def");
6037 pstext.addLine("/urx 0 def");
6038 pstext.addLine("/lly 900 def");
6039 pstext.addLine("/llx 900 def");
6040 pstext.addLine(" ");
6041 pstext.addLine("/showline{ %draws a line from an array of points");
6042 pstext.addLine("topath %stack: point_array. rgb_color");
6043 pstext.addLine("setrgbcolor");
6044 pstext.addLine("1 setlinejoin");
6045 pstext.addLine("stroke");
6046 pstext.addLine("} def");
6047 pstext.addLine(" ");
6048 pstext.addLine("/topath{ %makes a path from an array of points");
6049 pstext.addLine("/tmat exch def ");
6050 pstext.addLine("newpath");
6051 pstext.addLine("tmat 0 get scale mul tmat 1 get scale mul moveto");
6052 pstext.addLine("2 2 tmat length 1 sub");
6053 pstext.addLine("{");
6054 pstext.addLine("dup");
6055 pstext.addLine("tmat exch get");
6056 pstext.addLine("scale mul /x exch def");
6057 pstext.addLine("1 add");
6058 pstext.addLine("tmat exch get");
6059 pstext.addLine("scale mul /y exch def");
6060 pstext.addLine("x y lineto");
6061 pstext.addLine("}for");
6062 pstext.addLine("closepath");
6063 pstext.addLine("}def");
6064 pstext.addLine(" ");
6065 pstext.addLine("/showp{ %draws points from an array");
6066 pstext.addLine("/tmat exch def %stack: point_array. rgb_color");
6067 pstext.addLine("/b exch def");
6068 pstext.addLine("/g exch def");
6069 pstext.addLine("/r exch def");
6070 pstext.addLine("0 2 tmat length 1 sub");
6071 pstext.addLine("{");
6072 pstext.addLine("dup");
6073 pstext.addLine("tmat exch get");
6074 pstext.addLine("scale mul /x exch def");
6075 pstext.addLine("1 add");
6076 pstext.addLine("tmat exch get");
6077 pstext.addLine("scale mul neg /y exch def");
6078 pstext.addLine("newpath");
6079 pstext.addLine("x y 1 0 360 arc");
6080 pstext.addLine("r g b setrgbcolor");
6081 pstext.addLine("stroke");
6082 pstext.addLine("}for");
6083 pstext.addLine("}def");
6084 pstext.addLine(" ");
6085 pstext.addLine("/patternshape{");
6086 pstext.addLine("/size 0.5 def");
6087 pstext.addLine("moveto");
6088 pstext.addLine("size 2 div size 2 div rmoveto");
6089 pstext.addLine("0 size neg rlineto");
6090 pstext.addLine("size neg 0 rlineto");
6091 pstext.addLine("0 size rlineto");
6092 pstext.addLine("size 0 rlineto");
6093 pstext.addLine("} def");
6094 pstext.addLine("");
6095 pstext.addLine("/colorpattern{");
6096 pstext.addLine("/offsety exch def");
6097 pstext.addLine("/offsetx exch def");
6098 pstext.addLine("/b exch def");
6099 pstext.addLine("/g exch def");
6100 pstext.addLine("/r exch def");
6101 std::string st = vformat("/step %u def", ngroups);
6102 pstext.addLine(st);
6103 pstext.addLine("offsetx llx add step urx offsetx add{");
6104 pstext.addLine("/x exch def");
6105 pstext.addLine(" offsety lly add step ury offsety add{");
6106 pstext.addLine(" /y exch def");
6107 pstext.addLine(" newpath");
6108 pstext.addLine(" x y patternshape");
6109 pstext.addLine(" r g b setrgbcolor");
6110 pstext.addLine(" fill");
6111 pstext.addLine(" } for");
6112 pstext.addLine("} for");
6113 pstext.addLine("} def");
6114 pstext.addLine("");
6115 pstext.addLine("");
6116 pstext.addLine("");
6117 pstext.addLine("/minmax{");
6118 pstext.addLine("/tmat exch def");
6119 pstext.addLine("");
6120 pstext.addLine("0 2 tmat length 1 sub");
6121 pstext.addLine("{");
6122 pstext.addLine(" dup");
6123 pstext.addLine(" tmat exch get");
6124 pstext.addLine(" scale mul /x exch def");
6125 pstext.addLine(" 1 add");
6126 pstext.addLine(" tmat exch get");
6127 pstext.addLine(" scale mul /y exch def");
6128 pstext.addLine(" x urx gt{");
6129 pstext.addLine(" /urx x def");
6130 pstext.addLine(" }if");
6131 pstext.addLine(" x llx lt{");
6132 pstext.addLine(" /llx x def");
6133 pstext.addLine(" }if");
6134 pstext.addLine(" y ury gt{");
6135 pstext.addLine(" /ury y def");
6136 pstext.addLine(" }if");
6137 pstext.addLine(" y lly lt{");
6138 pstext.addLine(" /lly y def");
6139 pstext.addLine(" }if");
6140 pstext.addLine("}for");
6141 pstext.addLine("}def");
6142
6143 // Arrays
6144 for (i = 0; i < ngroups; i++)
6145 {
6146 pstext.addLine("[");
6147 for (j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++)
6148 {
6149 pstemp = place(ps, bl[i][j]);
6150 tst = vformat("%f %f", pstemp.x, pstemp.y);
6151 pstext.addLine(tst);
6152 }
6153 tst = (std::string) "]";
6154 pstext.addLine(tst);
6155 tst = vformat("/set%d exch def", i + 1);
6156 pstext.addLine(tst);
6157 tst = vformat("set%d minmax", i + 1);
6158 pstext.addLine(tst);
6159 pstext.addLine(" ");
6160 }
6161 pstext.addLine(" ");
6162
6163 // Draw sets
6164 pstext.addLine("%Begin program");
6165 pstext.addLine(" ");
6166
6167 UINT offset = 0;
6168 for (i = 0; i < ngroups; i++)
6169 {
6170 pstext.addLine("gsave");
6171 tst = vformat("set%d topath", i+1);
6172 pstext.addLine(tst);
6173 pstext.addLine("clip");
6174 tst = vformat("%f %f %f %u %u colorpattern", colors[i].red,
6175 colors[i].green, colors[i].blue, offset, offset);
6176 pstext.addLine(tst);
6177 pstext.addLine("grestore");
6178 offset++;
6179 }
6180 pstext.addLine(" ");
6181
6182 for (i = 0; i < ngroups; i++)
6183 {
6184 tst = vformat("%f %f %f set%d showline", colors[i].red,
6185 colors[i].green, colors[i].blue, i+1);
6186 pstext.addLine(tst);
6187 }
6188 pstext.addLine(" ");
6189
6190 /****Draw circles*/
6191 for (i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
6192 if (circles[i].mass > 0){
6193 pstemp = place(ps, circles[i]);
6194 pstext.addLine("newpath");
6195 if (pstemp.x > ps.minX() && pstemp.x < ps.maxX()){
6196 tst = vformat("%f %f %f 0 360 arc", pstemp.x,
6197 pstemp.y, pstemp.radius);
6198 pstext.addLine(tst);
6199 pstext.addLine("0.2 setlinewidth");
6200 pstext.addLine("1 0 0 setrgbcolor");
6201 pstext.addLine("stroke");
6202 }
6203 }
6204 }
6205 /*****/
6206 pstext.addLine("showpage");
6207 return pstext;
6208 }

6534 void interpolateToDist(float pDist){
6535 if (pDist <= 0){
6536 pDist = 1;
6537 }
6538
6539 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
6540 std::vector<point>tempbl;
6541 float pointDist = pDist;
6542 if (bl[i].size() < 5){
6543 pointDist = pDist / 10;
6544 }
6545 for(UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
6546 point current = bl[i][j];
6547 point nxt = bl[i][nextPoint(i, j)];
6548 float d = distance(current.x, current.y, nxt.x, nxt.y);
6549 UINT interpoints = ceil(d / pointDist);
6550 if (interpoints == 0)
6551 interpoints = 1;
6552 float dx = (float)(nxt.x - current.x);
6553 dx = dx / interpoints;
6554 float dy = (float)(nxt.y - current.y);
6555 dy = dy / interpoints;
6556 //tolog(toString(__LINE__) + "\n" + "Current: " + current.croack());
6557 for (UINT k = 0; k < interpoints; k++){
6558 point tempPoint;
6559 tempPoint.x = current.x + (k * dx);
6560 tempPoint.y = current.y + (k * dy);
6561 tempPoint.mass = POINT_MASS;
6562 //tolog(toString(__LINE__) + "\n" + "Interp: " + tempPoint.croack());
6563 tempbl.push_back(tempPoint);
6564 }
6565 //tolog(toString(__LINE__) + "\n" + "Next: " + nxt.croack());
6566 }
6567 bl[i] = tempbl;
6568 }
6569 avgStartDist = pDist;
6570 attachScene();
6571 }
6572
6573 void interpolate(UINT npoints)
6574 {
6575 UINT i, j, k;
6576 float dx, dy;
6577 float perim;
6578 float segment;
6579 UINT interpoints;
6580 point startPoint;
6581 point endPoint;
6582 point tempPoint;
6583 std::vector<point> tempv;
6584 std::vector<std::vector<point> > tempbl;
6585 npoints += (UINT) bl[0].size();
6586 for (i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++)
6587 {
6588 perim = perimeter(bl[i], true);
6589 nPointsMin = (UINT) (perim / bl.size());
6590 startPoint = bl[i][bl[i].size()-1];
6591 avgStartDist = perim / npoints;
6592 for (j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++)
6593 {
6594 endPoint = bl[i][j];
6595 segment = distance(startPoint.x, startPoint.y,
6596 endPoint.x, endPoint.y);
6597 interpoints = (int)(segment / avgStartDist);
6598 if (interpoints == 0)
6599 interpoints = 1;
6600 dx = (float)(endPoint.x - startPoint.x);
6601 dx = dx / interpoints;
6602 dy = (float)(endPoint.y - startPoint.y);
6603 dy = dy / interpoints;
6604 for (k = 0; k < interpoints; k++)
6605 {
6606 tempPoint.x = startPoint.x + (k * dx);
6607 tempPoint.y = startPoint.y + (k * dy);
6608 tempPoint.mass = POINT_MASS;
6609 tempv.push_back(tempPoint);
6610 }
6611 startPoint = endPoint;
6612 }
6613 tempbl.push_back(tempv);
6614 tempv.clear();
6615 }
6616 bl.clear();
6617 bl = tempbl;
6618 initOlds();
6619 attachScene();
6620 }

6666 void loadSignature(std::string sig){
6667 sig = exchangeChar(sig, '\n', 0x00);
6668 bl.clear();
6669 circles.clear();
6670 circRadii.clear();
6671 fromSignature = true;
6672 std::vector<std::string> rgroups;
6673 splitString nums(sig, ';');
6674 std::string nxt;
6675 nxt = purgeLetters(nums.next());
6676 seed = atoi(nxt.c_str());
6677 nxt = purgeLetters(nums.next());
6678 UINT ng = atoi(nxt.c_str());
6679 if (ng > 0){
6680 for (UINT j = 0; j < ng; j++){
6681 nxt = nums.next();
6682 rgroups.push_back(nxt);
6683 //bl.push_back({});
6684 }
6685 if (nums.finished()) setError("Incorrect input at middle");
6686 std::vector<std::vector<UINT>> tw;
6687 while (!nums.finished()){
6688 nxt = purgeLetters(nums.next());
6689 std::string nxt2 = purgeLetters(nums.next());
6690 std::vector<UINT> snd = {(UINT) std::atoi(nxt.c_str()), (UINT) std::atoi(nxt2.c_str())};
6691 tw.push_back(snd);
6692 }
6693 init(rgroups, tw);
6694 }
6695 else{
6696 setError("Incorrect input\n");
6697 return;
6698 }
6699 }

6875 bool setCycle(UINT stepNumber = 0){
6876 dataDisplay.clear();
6877 displayUINT("STEP", stepNumber);
6878 if (error){
6879 return false;
6880 }
6881 bool result = true;
6882 if (stepNumber == attract){
6883 setForcesFirstStep();
6884 solve();
6885 }
6886 else if (stepNumber == disperse){
6887 setForcesSecondStep();
6888 setContacts(false, true, 3*maxRad()*AIR);
6889 solve(true);
6890 }
6891 else if (stepNumber == minimizeCompactness){
6892 float thisOut = outCompactness(&optStep, &borderLine::furthestPoint,
6893 &borderLine::compactness, &borderLine::countCrossings);
6894 if (optStep.hasEnded()){
6895 if (thisOut < oc.optVal){
6896 oc.optVal = thisOut;
6897 oc.outCount = 0;
6898 //showCrossings();
6899 }
6900 else{
6901 oc.outCount = oc.outCount + 1;
6902 tolog("Outcount: " + toString(oc.outCount) + "\n");
6903 tolog("Cval: " + toString(oc.optVal) + "\n");
6904 }
6905 //fixTopology();
6906 }
6907 }
6908 else if (stepNumber == minimizeCrossings){
6909 float thisCross = outCompactness(&optStep, &borderLine::crossestPoint,
6910 &borderLine::countCrossings, &borderLine::compactness);
6911 if (optStep.hasEnded()){
6912 if (thisCross < oc.optVal){
6913 oc.optVal = thisCross;
6914 oc.outCount = 0;
6915 // Check for bad topology, restart if necessary
6916 fixTopology();
6917 setCheckTopol(true);
6918 if (checkTopol()){
6919 oc.maxOutCount *= 2;
6920 optStep.init(oc.optVal);
6921 }
6922 //showCrossings();
6923 }
6924 else{
6925 oc.outCount = oc.outCount + 1;
6926 tolog("Outcount: " + toString(oc.outCount) + "\n");
6927 }
6928 //fixTopology();
6929 }
6930 }
6931 else if (stepNumber == contract || stepNumber == refineCircles){
6932 scSolve();
6933 }
6934 else if (stepNumber == embellishLines){
6935 scSolve();
6936 oc.outCount++;
6937 }
6938 else{
6939 result = false;
6940 }
6941 return result;
6942 }
6943 bool isStepFinished(UINT stepNumber = 0){
6944 bool result = false;
6945 if (error == true){
6946 return true;
6947 }
6948 if (stepNumber == attract){
6949 float tc = maxCircleVsq;
6950 if (tc < 1e-2){
6951 result = true;
6952 }
6953 }
6954 else if (stepNumber == disperse){
6955 if (ngroups == 1 || minCircDist() > (2*maxRad()*AIR)){
6956 result = true;
6957 setCheckTopol(true);
6958 jiggleCircles();
6959 fixTopology();
6960 }
6961 }
6962 else if (stepNumber == minimizeCompactness || stepNumber == minimizeCrossings){
6963 if (oc.outCount > oc.maxOutCount){
6964 result = true;
6965 displayFloat("COMPACTNESS", compactness());
6966 displayUINT("CROSSINGS", countCrossings());
6967 setCheckTopol(true);
6968 fixTopology();
6969 }
6970 }
6971 else if (stepNumber == contract || stepNumber == refineCircles){
6972 result = isSimulationComplete();
6973 }
6974 else if (stepNumber == embellishLines){
6975 result = isSimulationComplete();
6976 if (result){
6977 blSettings.smoothSVG = true;
6978 //currentStep = 1;
6979 }
6980 //if (getMaxVsq() > 1e-7){
6981 // result = false;
6982 //}
6983 }
6984 refreshScreen++;
6985 return result;
6986 }

6991 void rotateScene(float alpha){
6992 centerScene();
6993 float cosa = std::cos(alpha);
6994 float sina = std::sin(alpha);
6995 std::vector<std::vector<point>> newbl;
6996 std::vector<point> newcirc;
6997 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
6998 newbl.push_back({});
6999 for (UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
7000 point t;
7001 t.x = cosa * bl[i][j].x + sina * (bl[i][j].y);
7002 t.y = -sina * bl[i][j].x + cosa * (bl[i][j].y);
7003 newbl[i].push_back(t);
7004 }
7005 }
7006 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
7007 point t = circles[i];
7008 t.x = cosa * circles[i].x + sina * (circles[i].y);
7009 t.y = -sina * circles[i].x + cosa * (circles[i].y);
7010 newcirc.push_back(t);
7011 }
7012 bl = newbl;
7013 circles = newcirc;
7014 resetScale();
7015 }

7112 float estimateExhaustiveRunTime(UINT level = 0){
7113 UINT nest = 50;
7114 float result = 0;
7115 std::vector<std::vector<UINT>> all = exMinimize(level);
7116 UINT n = all.size();
7117 if (n > nest){
7118 std::vector<std::vector<UINT>> test;
7119 test.insert(test.begin(), all.begin(), all.begin() + nest);
7120 exStart();
7121 auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
7122 exTest(test);
7123 auto endat = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
7124 std::chrono::duration<float> elapsed = endat - start;
7125 float elap = (float) elapsed.count();
7126 result = elap * n / nest;
7127 }
7128 return result;
7129 }

7143
7160 bool simulate(bool exhaustive = false, UINT maxlevel = 0){
7161 restart_log();
7162 reset();
7163 if (exhaustive){
7164 std::vector<std::vector<UINT>> totry = exMinimize(maxlevel);
7165 exSimul(totry);
7166 return true;
7167 }
7168 else{
7169 UINT cstep = currentStep;
7170 for (UINT step = currentStep; step < 8; step++){
7171 bool bQuit = false;
7172 bool success = setStep(step);
7173 if (!success) return false;
7174 while (!bQuit){
7175 setCycle(step);
7176 if (err()){
7177 //std::cout << errorMessage << std::endl;
7178 bQuit = true;
7179 }
7180 //if (refreshScreen.isMax()) writeSVG();
7181 if (isStepFinished(step)){
7182 bQuit = true;
7183 }
7184 }
7185 cstep = step;
7186 }
7187 currentStep = cstep;
7188 return true;
7189 }
7190 }
